title: OHE (Overhead Equipment) Tripping
description: Multiple breaker trips reported on the UP line between New Delhi (NDLS) and Mathura. Power supply interrupted, affecting traction.

title: Track Circuit Failure
description: Track circuit dropping continuously at Home Signal of Kanpur Central (CNB). Signal aspect remaining red, causing trailing delays.

title: Medical Emergency
description: Passenger requiring urgent medical assistance in coach B4. Doctor requested at the next commercial halt (Prayagraj Jn).

title: Point Motor Failure
description: Point no. 4A/B failing to set in normal position. Route cannot be locked for main line reception. Manual clamping initiated.

title: Pantograph Entanglement
description: Loco pantograph entangled with OHE contact wire. Substantial damage to pantograph. Relief loco requested from shed.

title: Waterlogging on Tracks
description: Heavy rainfall leading to waterlogging above rail level at Mumbai Central (MMCT) yard. Speed restriction of 10 kmph imposed.

title: Cattle Runover (CRO)
description: Cattle runover reported in block section. Loco pilot checking for damage to BP/FP air hoses. Train halted in section.

title: Brake Binding
description: Smoke reported from coach S5 due to brake binding. Train stopped out of course for isolation of brake cylinder.

title: Alarm Chain Pulling (ACP)
description: Unscheduled train halt due to ACP in coach S2. Guard and RPF investigating the cause.

title: Level Crossing Gate Malfunction
description: Interlocked LC gate no. 42 boom damaged by road vehicle. Gate cannot be locked, trains piloted at 15 kmph.

title: Loco Traction Failure
description: Traction motor isolation failed in WAP-7 loco. Unable to haul load. Assisting engine (banking) requested.

title: Hot Axle Detected
description: Acoustic bearing detector triggered hot axle warning for wagon 42. Detachment required at next loop line.

title: Platform Overcrowding
description: Platform 1 density exceeded 90% capacity due to delayed arrival of two major expresses. RPF deployment requested.

title: Vande Bharat Window Damage
description: Stone pelting incident reported in section resulting in cracked exterior glass of coach C4. No injuries reported.

title: Route Relay Interlocking (RRI) Reboot
description: RRI panel unresponsive. System reboot initiated by S&T team. All signals reverted to danger temporarily.
